accounts.title: Accounts
acct.add.key.note: This key is not part of any recovery phrase. Back it up separately.
acct.hardware.soon: Ledger over USB (extension) lands with M5; Ledger Bluetooth, Trezor and Keystone with M8. Until then you can watch the device address.
acct.sync.hint.body: Watch and hardware accounts sync; seeds and keys never do. Pair in Settings › Devices.
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Sends, swaps and everything the wallet signs will appear here, with what you were shown when you signed.
activity.title: Activity
approval.blocked: BoltVault will not sign this. See why above.
approval.connect.body: The site will see this address and can ask you to sign. It cannot move anything without a signature.
approval.none.body: This request was already decided or has expired.
approval.nopreview: No balance preview on this network — only the revert check ran.
approval.watch.body: Add a token this site suggests to your list. Its details are checked against the chain before it shows.
backup.body: Enter your password to show the words, write them down, then confirm three of them.
backup.done: Backed up. Swapping and signing are unlocked.
backup.none: Every seed in this vault is backed up.
backup.title: Back up your recovery phrase
devices.answer.show: Show this to the first device, then compare the codes.
devices.answer.title: Scan the other device’s code
devices.offer.then: Then scan (or paste) the answer it shows.
devices.offer.title: Scan this on the other device
devices.sas.body: Both devices show a six-digit code. Confirm only if they match exactly.
devices.sas.title: Compare the codes
devices.title: Devices & sync
devices.what: Paired devices share settings, per-site chains and watch/hardware accounts. Seeds and keys never sync — move a vault with the export code in Security.
explore.soon: Markets are on Electroneum. This list fills in with the M6 milestone.
explore.title: Explore Electroneum
home.backup.body: Swapping and signing stay locked until you confirm three words. Watching and receiving work now.
home.backup.title: Back up your recovery phrase
home.collectibles.empty: No collectibles yet. Explore collections on Electroneum.
home.create.body: Create a new recovery phrase or import one you already have. Electroneum is your home chain.
home.create.title: Your vault is not created yet
home.fund.body: This is Electroneum Smart Chain (52014). Send ETN here from an exchange that supports the smart chain, or bridge USDC from Ethereum — you will need a little ETN for fees.
home.fund.title: Receive ETN to get started
home.locked.body: Unlock to see balances and sign.
home.locked.title: Locked
home.positions.empty: No farm positions, open orders or bridges in flight.
moments.title: Signature moments
ob.done.body: Send ETN here from an exchange that supports the smart chain, or bridge USDC from Ethereum — you will need a little ETN for fees. Do not send from the old Electroneum app.
ob.done.title: This is Electroneum Smart Chain (52014)
ob.hardware.note: Ledger, Trezor and Keystone accounts are added from the Accounts sheet after your vault exists.
ob.import.title: Enter your recovery phrase
ob.passkey.body: Your face or fingerprint unlocks the vault on this device. Your password still works, and it is still needed to reveal or export the phrase.
ob.passkey.noprf: This browser created a passkey without the PRF feature, so it cannot unlock the vault on its own. Use your password.
ob.passkey.title: Unlock with a passkey?
ob.password.body: It seals your vault on this device. A few unrelated words beat a short string of symbols. We cannot reset it.
ob.password.title: Choose a password
ob.preview.body: Wallets derive accounts along two common trees. BoltVault uses the standard (BIP-44) tree; Ledger Live uses another. Both agree on the first address.
ob.preview.title: Which addresses do you recognise?
ob.quiz.body: Type the words at these positions. This is the backup check that unlocks swapping and signing.
ob.quiz.title: Confirm three words
ob.watch.body: You will see balances and activity but cannot send or sign. Add a key or pair a device later.
ob.watch.title: Watch an address
ob.welcome.body: BoltVault keeps your recovery phrase on this device, sealed with your password. Nothing leaves it unless you export it.
ob.welcome.title: Your keys, your Electroneum
ob.words.body: This is the only copy. Anyone with these words controls your funds; BoltVault will never ask for them except on this screen and the quiz.
ob.words.title: Write these 12 words down, in order
pw.ok: Usable — a longer phrase is stronger
quiz.wrong: Those words do not match your phrase. Check the numbers and try again.
receive.soon: Receive lands with the M4 milestone.
receive.title: Receive
reveal.body: Enter your password. Make sure nobody can see your screen.
reveal.title: Recovery phrase · {label}
security.about: Encryption: Argon2id → XChaCha20-Poly1305, one data key per vault, wrapped per unlock factor.
security.export: Move this vault to another device
security.export.body: An animated code the other device scans, sealed under a one-time phrase you type there. Your seeds never touch the internet.
security.export.hint: Type this on the other device. It is not shown there.
security.passkeys.none: No passkey enrolled. A passkey unlocks the vault with your face or fingerprint on this device; the password stays required for reveal and export.
security.passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys with the PRF feature are not available in this browser or on this device.
security.title: Security
send.soon: Send lands with the M4 milestone.
send.title: Send
settings.devices.rows: Pair a phone or browser; move your vault
settings.spending.rows: Slippage, approvals, step-ups, wallet fee schedule
sites.none: No site is connected. When a site asks to connect, it appears here with the account and chain it sees.
sites.note: Each site keeps its own chain. Changing the Home chain never changes a site.
sites.title: Connected sites
swap.soon: Swapping arrives with the M5 milestone. Quotes are on-chain; every in-wallet swap pays the wallet fee to the fee sink.
token.soon: The token dossier lands with the M4 milestone.
token.title: Token
unlock.help: Forgot the password? There is no reset. Restore from your recovery phrase on a fresh install instead.
unlock.passkey.fail: The passkey did not unlock the vault. Use your password.
unlock.title: Unlock BoltVault
unlock.wrong: That password does not open this vault.
watch.label: Watch address
